metadata.question: From January to mid-May, did Jaén a few miles east of Córdoba recieve more than 3 inches of rain fall in 2023?

data.raw_code: The question is about rainfall in Jaén, Spain (east of Córdoba) from January to mid-May 2023, specifically whether it received more than 3 inches of rain. 1. Data source: I should use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which provides daily precipitation data. 2. Location: Jaén, Spain. I need to create a point geometry for Jaén. 3. Time period: January 1, 2023 to May 15, 2023. 4. Units: CHIRPS provides precipitation in mm, so I need to convert 3 inches to mm (3 inches = 76.2 mm). 5. Processing: Sum the precipitation over the time period and check if > 76.2 mm. I need to: - Check if collection has data - Calculate total precipitation - Validate the result - Handle edge cases (no data, no pixels, calculation failure) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions geometry = ee.Geometry.Point([-3.7833, 37.7667]) # Jaén, Spain coordinates start_date = '2023-01-01' end_date = '2023-05-15' # 2. Data Acquisition precip_col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(geometry) # Check if collection has data if precip_col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No precipitation data found for the period.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over the period total_precip = precip_col.select('precipitation').sum() # Check valid pixels pixel_count = total_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geometry, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo() if pixel_count == 0: print("No valid precipitation pixels.") print("C2") else: # 4. Calculation - Get total precipitation in mm precip_mm = total_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geometry, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Final Answer if precip_mm is None: print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") else: # Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) precip_inches = precip_mm / 25.4 print(f"Total precipitation: {precip_inches:.2f} inches ({precip_mm:.1f} mm)") print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}") if precip_inches > 3: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
geometry = ee.Geometry.Point([-3.7833, 37.7667])  # Jaén, Spain coordinates
start_date = '2023-01-01'
end_date = '2023-05-15'

# 2. Data Acquisition
precip_col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(geometry)

# Check if collection has data
if precip_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No precipitation data found for the period.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over the period
    total_precip = precip_col.select('precipitation').sum()
    
    # Check valid pixels
    pixel_count = total_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=geometry,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    if pixel_count == 0:
        print("No valid precipitation pixels.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculation - Get total precipitation in mm
        precip_mm = total_precip.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=geometry,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        if precip_mm is None:
            print("Calculation failed.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            # Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm)
            precip_inches = precip_mm / 25.4
            print(f"Total precipitation: {precip_inches:.2f} inches ({precip_mm:.1f} mm)")
            print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}")
            
            if precip_inches > 3:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
